selection: First record of frozen public test in saved order; chosen before MOSS output
purpose: Feasibility pilot, not a cohort benchmark or independent confirmation
decoding: Official default prompt, deterministic generation, no hotwords or reference text; max_new_tokens 8192; stop and retain failure if truncated
metrics: Native original CHAT word MLU, eligible utterance count and length SD, TNW/NDW/TTR/MATTR; WER separately; learned model frozen; anonymous speaker ID mapping disclosed separately, no gold word edits
scope: Full original 300-second task; if runtime infeasible, declare smaller pilot before generation and retain full-task registration
budget: First-run setup/inference capped at 15 minutes; earlier download failure is not inference
